name: Deiveson Figueiredo
summary: A two-time flyweight champion now at bantamweight and 39, with 1-4 in his last five. The power and submission threat remain; the speed and durability to deliver them look like they're going.

how_they_fight.Striking: Heavy hands and a counter left hook built his flyweight run, but at 135 he's been out-landed by bigger, longer men (about 2.6 significant strikes landed a minute against 3.2 absorbed).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Leans more on grappling since moving up (UFC.com): chokes from front headlocks and scrambles are his best finishing routes now.
how_they_fight.Defense & durability: Stopped by Cory Sandhagen (a knee injury, 2025) and submitted by Song Yadong (May 2026). Decision losses to Petr Yan and Umar Nurmagomedov were clear.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Starts fast; historically fades when fights go long, and he's older now.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced and dangerous early; lacks answers for length and volume.

patterns: Hunts chokes when opponents duck in or shoot
keys_to_beat: Don't shoot carelessly into his front headlock
Push the pace into the second and third rounds
